data.field_of_study: natural science; pharmacy; data science; pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare relevant fundamental or applied studies
data.evidence_sentence: Students from Germany who are going abroad for a study project or practical work experience or students from abroad who are studying, researching or doing an internship in Germany can apply.
data.notes: Page gives no concrete deadline, only a link to updated deadlines. Funding is described as individual financial funding up to 10,000 EUR, so funding_type is partial. Duration up to 6 months. Stated target group is students enrolled in Master's or PhD programmes. Page is a DAAD database listing for the Bayer Foundation scholarship; the page does not state a specific host university. Field list taken from target group subjects; 'all scientific disciplines' in description is broader and not fully reflected.
